title: The area the residue gives: π
caption: The residue calculation gives ∫ dx/(1 + x²) = 2πi × 1/(2i) = π: exactly the area under this bell-shaped curve, which tails off so fast that almost all of it lies between −6 and 6.
alt: A bell-shaped curve 1/(1 + x²) with height 1 at x = 0, shaded between x = −6 and 6, tailing off to zero on both sides.
description: The integrand 1/(1 + x²) has height 1 at x = 0 and falls towards 0 on both sides.
The residue at the pole i is 1/(2i), so the integral is 2πi × 1/(2i) = π.
The shaded area under the curve is that number: π ≈ 3.14.

checks.name: the area under 1/(1 + x²) is π (computed out to ±1,000, where the rest is 0.002)
